entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer supporting multi-level states for users, sessions, and agents. Available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or managed cloud, it features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval to enhance agent intelligence.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes information as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains, providing observable retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This memory engine features a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication to sustain sub-300ms recall at high volumes. It combines RAG with automated fact extraction and includes native connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Serving as an opinionated brain for Hermes, this project utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges to synthesize answers. It is designed for multi-user team environments, offering scoped access, citations, and gap analysis.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides a long-term memory workflow focused on retaining, recalling, and reflecting on information. It is compatible with over 25 LLM providers and supports multiple programming languages including Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library enables stateful agents through a FastAPI server that supports hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection. It serves as the upstream foundation for self-hosted Hermes memory implementations using Python or TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Operating under the Elastic License 2.0, this provider treats memory as a git repository with version control features like branching and merging. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance across a plain markdown context tree.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that achieves sub-millisecond performance using a single SQLite database. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) via stdio or SSE, providing a streamlined Python SDK for direct operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system manages persistent memory through Qdrant and structured facts to create an auto-curated wiki. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context within a local Docker-based infrastructure.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness uses outcome-gated promotion to improve context bundles and playbooks over time. It integrates with MCP clients and OpenAI-compatible endpoints to help agents succeed on complex, multi-step tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management by storing messages in a SQLite-backed DAG with full-text search metadata. It builds depth-aware summary nodes, allowing agents to search and expand compacted material without losing historical data.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This wrapper enables private, cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent by self-hosting the Honcho backend. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible provider or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that ensures portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy and supports direct data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open YAML engram format to store human-readable data locally for multi-agent systems. It integrates with tools like Claude Code and Cursor using hybrid retrieval powered by BM25 and local embedders.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs a combination of BM25 and vector search to provide local-first memory through MCP and dedicated agent plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference by using block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It offers native support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem, reducing prefill latency by 1.5–3× while saving up to 36% in token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that relies on SQLite with FTS5 search rather than vector databases or embeddings. The project features a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recalled memory with a reason for its selection. It supports embedded in-process operation and includes features for contradiction tracking, recency ranking, and multi-user owner-scoping.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel that unifies Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes agents. It manages state and retrieval using a stack of SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver specific evidence packets for every query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs to populate a local cache. Built for the Hermes 2026 Hackathon, it utilizes SQLite-vec and GGUF models to provide an MCP-native server for coding agents.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn establishes a cross-project memory layer that uses a user's own Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It avoids opaque databases by storing memory as inspectable Markdown files while using DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory through semantic search that combines BM25 full-text indexing with ranked graph traversal. It automatically indexes codebases and multimedia via OCR, creating bidirectional relationships between notes using edge tags.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus reduces prompt tokens by 94% by resolving live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens. It operates locally via a Rust-based MCP server and renders these facts into files like AGENTS.md or .cursorrules.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility focuses on reducing tool-schema overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings and is designed specifically to optimize native tool search functionality.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to manage agent memory without external dependencies. It features a unique 1-10 importance ranking system to prioritize high-value information during context prefetch and uses BM25-first retrieval for keyword accuracy.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: A Git-backed workflow layer that tracks durable Markdown context files for coding agents. It provides a shared lifecycle core for managing session handoffs and includes a migration workflow for importing existing chat and project data.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin focuses on data integrity by supporting immediate event deletion and providing a trace.jsonl audit log of all operations. It uses an on-demand summarizer to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall accuracy.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. The plugin ensures reliability using a local SQLite layer and a write outbox for managing state updates and semantic searches.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables Hermes agents to handle financial transactions using USDC and stablecoins across ten different blockchain families, including EVM and Solana. It allows APIs to charge for access and agents to pay for services autonomously with minimal code integration.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local capabilities such as scripts, runbooks, and MCP configurations into a searchable artifact graph. It supports implicit feedback learning and provides native tools for traversing indexed skills to improve automated tool routing.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It features configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory provider that prioritizes security with default AES-256-GCM encryption at rest. It supports multiple retrieval methods, including HNSW ANN and sparse recall, and can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin enables private, local code memory for repositories through a required SourceVault server for vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search and grounded Q&A within a codebase.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers a suite of 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It utilizes a hybrid search approach combining BM25, vector, and graph methods, alongside automatic context checkpointing during message compression.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements subagent-driven development to enable autonomous task execution for Hermes Agent. It enforces technical rigor through red-green-refactor TDD and YAGNI principles while integrating with multiple coding harnesses.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that enables Hermes Agent to generate web, mobile, and desktop prototypes via a dedicated CLI. It supports design and prototyping workflows across macOS and Windows desktop applications.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 domains, mapped to industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It equips agents with specialized security knowledge compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee functions as a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that gives agents persistent long-term memory across sessions. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and offers clients in Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows agents to generate editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions using 11 diagram presets. It includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure the accuracy of Mermaid-to-diagram conversions.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 permissions, and x402 payments. It includes a master router and a verification layer to handle escrow and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass detection process and a 112-entry word replacement table. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, and Cursor for content refinement.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw uses an Agentic Evolver to automate skill deduplication and quality improvement across multiple sessions. It synchronizes skill libraries across different devices and team environments for collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library features 12 metaskills that preserve state within a local directory for agentskills.io-compatible agents. The skills are available as spec-conformant plugins designed to maintain context across workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: A collection of 1,153 professional agent skills provided in plain markdown format for native use in Hermes Agent. It includes ready-to-paste exports for various other assistants including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill enables Hermes Agent to extract transcripts, search results, channel data, and playlists from YouTube. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with several coding agents including OpenClaw and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage new skills via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions and analytical lenses for specific tasks. It enhances output quality by reporting findings alongside a detailed analysis of potential blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides modular packages for Pydantic AI that support programmatic skills and remote registries. It utilizes progressive disclosure to maintain prompt efficiency while managing instructions, resources, and scripts.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different project scales and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the original documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro provides a harness for long-running agents using a three-level work model and structured memory via file-backed or SQLite cards. It includes a dedicated CLI for managing tasks and cards to support cross-feature learning.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin establishes cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It creates a pipeline for fine-tuning replacement models, allowing an agent to effectively train its own successor.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interaction with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports integration with CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, alongside specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository serves the Brazilian community by providing Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configurations in Portuguese. All skills follow the SKILL.md format and the agentskills.io standard for interoperability.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration and prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 image generation models. The suite also includes six specialized skills specifically designed for FLUX 3 video generation.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts existing code repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned, agentskills.io-compliant skills. It ensures transparency by providing provenance through specific file and line number citations.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with built-in recursive dependency resolution. It features a Python client and CLI, while supporting commerce through TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill enables autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It ensures reliability through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project introduces a local-first workflow language that treats intent as code through a Rust binary and four core verbs. It enhances agent reliability by auditing permissions and costs before execution and generating hash-chained receipts for every run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, calendars, and contacts via standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication through HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon to maintain persistent connections and incrementally fetch server metadata.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle Eye provides a five-layer retrieval system that combines hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow down skill lists. This approach reduces token consumption and features graceful degradation if specific embedding dependencies are unavailable.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only security tool uses parallel subagents to attack code from multiple angles, including exploitability and integration impact. It triages findings using a deterministic pre-scan with tools like Semgrep and verifies vulnerabilities via sandbox execution.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub serves as a community repository for browsing and installing skills using the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This ADHD-friendly execution system uses a local SQLite database to manage habits and study blocks without cloud synchronization. It allows an AI agent to handle system design via the Model Context Protocol while the user focuses on task completion.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts for various interfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram, achieving token reductions of 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and reproduction within Hermes. It features a Python goal engine for state management and enforces multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a trio of agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify codebases. It supports multiple languages including Rust and Go, utilizing a tiered application process with a final approval gate.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files and automatically registers common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab equips Hermes with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to address CVE-driven scenarios.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible repository demonstrations using vhs or Playwright. It optimizes the resulting GIF files to remain under 8 MB and embeds them directly into the project's README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language descriptions. It maintains reliability by validating skills against runtime-specific profiles and monitoring official frontmatter specs for drift.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This project provides a CLI and MCP server to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It facilitates tool discovery and provides direct installation commands for compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the Hermes Agent and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill actually works.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills enable deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The tool ensures environment-specific path syntax is used and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for creating bounty boards and buying context, with 85% of the payment going to the winning answer.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It utilizes semantic memory to expand searches based on user interests and produces structured reports with AI-driven analysis.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides local OCR for PDFs and images alongside video-to-text transcription capabilities. It also features an e-commerce studio for batch material generation with brand overlays and tools for refining AI-generated text.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project exposes 191 tools and five production-grade skills through a hosted MCP server for structured web data access. It supports integration with multiple AI environments including Claude, Cursor, and OpenHands.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes, to ensure reproducible environments. The packages are automatically updated on a daily basis to maintain parity with upstream releases.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository offers scripts and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for the Antigravity CLI and utilizes Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This tool provides a one-line Termux command to install Hermes Agent on Android devices with support for over 200 AI models. It features a built-in gateway service to manage incoming connections directly from the mobile environment.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart enables Hermes Agent deployment on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both standard deployments and operator-ready workflows, including configurable gateway modes for API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android (via Termux) and iOS (via iSH) platforms. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs on Android.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project implements hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web searches and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This repository provides a Docker-based sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to build specific versions of Hermes using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative deployment of Hermes Agent, including configuration for workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix or systemd EnvironmentFiles for secure secrets handling.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes and OpenClaw agents across Docker and Kubernetes clusters. It tracks per-agent metrics and LLM budget caps while providing access through REST, CLI, and MCP interfaces.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane manages multiple Hermes Agent instances with RBAC-controlled access and separate workspaces. It facilitates hierarchy-aware communication for inter-agent delegation and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Designed for production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is optimized for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs without a graphical interface.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable distribution allows Hermes to run from USB drives or external storage without host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python 3.12 and rescue tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM providers to deploy specialized agents for technical, sentiment, news, fundamental, and analysis tasks. It features a researcher team that assesses insights through structured debates.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This orchestration tool supports workflows for CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, and other frameworks through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API. It provides capabilities for task tracking, scheduling, and monitoring spend.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web dashboard for managing parallel coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It utilizes git worktrees for management and offers optional Docker or Podman sandboxing.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single VPS agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, registry management, and VPS setup.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework employs a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from single agents to automated teams. It provides bundled skills for backup management, security auditing, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using over 23 LLM providers. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture governed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Codegraph provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph designed to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It features an auto-sync capability and runs entirely on local hardware across Windows, macOS, and Linux systems.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool tracks token consumption and associated costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. Users can monitor usage through a 3D visualization dashboard and optionally submit data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: Claude-tap is a local trace viewer that allows developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools. It enhances security by redacting authentication headers before recording and offers a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates directly with Hermes Agent and other markdown-supporting providers to streamline the UI development process.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This real-time widget monitors tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and other CLI tools directly. It supports real-time data synchronization across multiple machines to track account limits and session details.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: Oh-my-hermes acts as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows to support autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers community-created skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Developers can use YAML-based configurations to modify ASCII art banners, spinners, and colors with aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: Hermes-CCC ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, enabling native execution without external processes or OAuth. The package includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing identity registration with human-readable handles. It facilitates secure agent-to-agent communication via the Signal Protocol and enables commerce using Solana-based payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel-browser is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control through the Model Context Protocol. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing agent workflows and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides a memory system for platforms like VS Code and Slack using a two-tier architecture of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports various frameworks including CrewAI, LangGraph, and the Google ADK.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research and DevOps, featuring an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while managing specific skills and custom instructions at the directory level.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a complete hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup that includes support for 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter designed to validate AI agent configurations and system prompts by flagging vague tool descriptions and missing stop conditions. It performs deterministic local checks without LLM calls and supports SARIF and JSON output for integration into CI/CD pipelines.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, skills, and memory archives into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also handles nested authentication structures and configures systemd gateway services for the new environment.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability platform monitors multi-agent systems using passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It features a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This project adds a local voice interface to Hermes Agent, featuring an open mic with wake word support and adaptive turn-taking. It operates entirely offline across 35 languages using Piper and Kokoro, requiring no API keys or external accounts.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This local-first skill uses dynamic slash commands and a deterministic runtime to help users generate revenue via Hermes Agent. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for any external actions or writes and utilizes a bounded JSON adapter.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for handling configurations across Windows, macOS, and Linux. It functions as an all-in-one controller for Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that integrates external agents such as Hermes Agent and Claude Code into a single environment. It features built-in assistants for generating editable office documents and supports remote access through a WebUI or messaging platforms like Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This interface runs the Hermes agent in-process using existing configurations and provides a three-panel layout with integrated workspace file browsing. It is designed for accessibility across browsers and mobile devices via secure SSH tunneling.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the initial experience through guided installation and provider setup for multiple AI services. It offers a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and provider configurations.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard facilitates multi-platform interaction by managing 10 platform channels including Slack and WhatsApp alongside visual Kanban boards. It provides advanced monitoring features such as streaming responses, tool traces, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task handling. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and specialized managers for agent skills and memory.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from fourteen different agents, allowing users to delegate tasks via @ mentions in a single thread. It supports unattended task execution on separate git branches to facilitate later review.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for managing sessions and cron jobs. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair, paired with native views for Kanban and skills.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes a built-in kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing dedicated UI components for MCP tools and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to local, cloud, or remote Hermes runtimes. It features an MV3 controller for approved tab actions and a site-aware drafting assistant compatible with 31 writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ designed to drive self-hosted agents by pairing with a hermes-webui server. It allows mobile users to manage tasks and skills while providing read-only access to agent memory and analytics.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for multiple engines and includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency. It provides a live monitoring environment specifically for observing code writes and diffs in real-time.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard serves as a comprehensive control plane for the Hermes stack, featuring a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking kanban pipelines. It distinguishes itself by providing real-time tool call visualization and a dedicated interface for managing MCP server lifecycles.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and analytics cockpit designed to track limits and session history for Hermes and 12 other coding-agent CLIs. It operates without telemetry on macOS 14+ and offers a one-click resume feature for supported command-line interfaces.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates the management of Hermes Agents running on Orgo cloud VMs or SSH hosts. It streamlines deployment with one-click automated installations on fresh cloud computers and includes an integrated WebRTC voice mode powered by OpenAI Realtime.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based interface. It focuses on safety and oversight by providing a dedicated approval inbox for agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This project provides a terminal user interface (TUI) and dashboard built with OpenTUI for managing Hermes Agent sessions and profiles. It includes specialized views for task management via a kanban board and tools for configuring agent skills and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for the Telegram Mini App v2.0 platform that supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. The interface includes a terminal chat with file attachment support and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows-based desktop GUI requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights, making it a highly portable option for running Hermes. It supports both cloud and local models via LM Studio and features a dynamic tool maker for creating custom API and Python handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It offers integrated management tools for organizing skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside a built-in file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring, allowing users to track session activity, costs, and environment variables in real time. It provides a read-only environment for inspecting conversation histories and the source code of active skills.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that utilizes tool approval cards and SSE streaming to manage agent interactions. It features an integrated marketplace for discovering MCP servers and supports isolated profiles to maintain separate memory and API keys for different sessions.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client coordinates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a central PM orchestrator. It includes a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports real-time model switching during streaming chat sessions.
